profile.long_bio: Jonathan E. Abogye is a final-year Computer Engineering student at Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria, graduating in September 2026. He builds production web and mobile applications end to end, from data model and API through to interface, and works on control systems design and physical simulation on the engineering side. He also teaches: he founded and runs Genesis Engineer, a one-month intensive tech bootcamp, and mentors students through COESA.
